title: Production P0 password-reset read-only diagnostic
acceptance: the owner-only command is accepted only on release issue 3072 and contains one exact UUID correlation identifier
the workflow checks out exact current main, validates the registered four-path contract and fails closed if main moves before evidence publication
the active REG.RU API and Web containers are uniquely resolved inside one Compose project, healthy and bound to one matching immutable revision
only boolean readiness for API_URL, web/API password-reset delivery keys, key equality and transactional mail is published
only an allowlisted correlated failure class and bounded safe detail are derived from the named request; account hashes, email, tokens, environment values and raw logs are never published
the diagnostic does not run SQL, call auth endpoints, create challenges, reset credentials, alter sessions or MFA, restart containers, deploy images or mutate production
the result records exact diagnostic main and deployed API/Web revision while preserving production mutation NONE
